ui.scope: Real Backup/shared-shell scenes with fake external operation owners. Headless layout and interaction; no configured game autoloads, user persistence, real backup transactions or GPU raster proof.

font_probe.scope: Real bundled-font layout measurements using draft UI labels; no production UI or approved-translation claim.

desktop_regression.scope: Real MainGameScene, desktop, Contacts and Settings scenes/controller; real ProfileManager and LocalizationManager explicitly initialized with a shared mutation gate and in-memory FakeFileOps for cross-app routing. Contacts projection and desktop host are fakes. Covers launcher/shared strip, multilingual layout, clock, navigation and cache focus. No configured game autoloads, player persistence, full Bootstrap startup or GPU raster proof.

contacts_regression.scope: Real Contacts and shared-shell scene integration with fake application ports, isolated headless Godot; no game autoloads or user persistence. Not GPU raster proof.

operations.scope: Real SaveManager and BackupPresentationPort over in-memory FileOps, real journal/schema/restore transaction; external presentation owners faked; no user saves.
operations.collateral_disposition: Four unexercised copied UI scripts changed during final custody and risk fixes. Owner, port, schema, journal, restore and storage sources match; current UI separately compiles and passes the UI and regression receipts. Original receipt retained unchanged.

storage.scope: FakeFileOps only; existing GUT storage suite, raw inspection, revision overwrite/delete, operation fault positions, persisted crash snapshots, foreign hash and marker refusal. No player file access.

requirements.composition: UI verifies 800x656 body, nine fixed row-major drawers, one selection, modes and pinned status/actions.
requirements.readability: Actual bundled fonts en/zh-CN/zh-HK at100/125/150. Measured fixed compact font roles; full labels; unknown legacy time retained.
requirements.operations: Actual owner covers save/overwrite/delete/load/fallback/cancel, stale target/source, timestamps, capability and single-owner routing. Fake-owner UI contracts independently reviewed.
requirements.custody_and_lifecycle: Cancel-first host modal, inert background, recovery focus and live Retry removal, Home/Back, refreshed cache, hidden-cache Home preservation, day eviction and restored Backup.
requirements.storage: 1644 assertions, 578 injected I/O positions, 703 restart snapshots; original storage8/8. Owner regression suites6/6,7/7,13/13.
requirements.review: ui-review.md includes independent source and receipt review; data agent independently reviewed storage; orchestrator reviewed reviewer-authored risk polish.

limits: In-run Backup only; not every UI dossier, formal UI-00/UI-00R cutover, title/Pause hosting, global shortcuts or full game.
Headless UI and separate owner/storage fixtures do not prove full startup, GPU raster quality, physical input/accessibility or real-disk power-loss durability.
Existing semantic scene-readiness contract retained. No complete end-to-end full-game save/restore claim.
Legacy/fallback time is unknown without durable evidence. Localized wording and operational glyphs are working design. No Bloom/fingerprint art fabricated.
Original logs retain root-certificate and inherited Unicode NUL diagnostics; passing does not imply clean diagnostics.
Tests never read or write actual player saves. Root/destination dirty state and historical recovery work remain separate.
